# syq 0.11.0

This release adds `syq find` and `syq ls` across local filesystems, SSH
servers and S3 buckets, copies directly between an SSH server and an S3 bucket
from your own machine, lowers the Python SDK requirement to Python 3.10+, and
speeds up S3 and filesystem copies.

## Highlights

- `syq find` and `syq ls` stream matching files and directories locally, over
  SSH (`--on HOST`), or in S3 (`--on s3://BUCKET`), with `--depth`, `--ignore`,
  `--where`, `--long`, `--null`, and `--json`. The Python SDK adds matching
  `syq.find()` and `syq.ls()` streams.
- `syq cp` can copy directly between an SSH server and an S3 bucket from your
  own machine (`--from server --to s3://bucket` and the reverse). Data travels
  directly between the server and storage while your machine (or `--auth-from
  @NAME`) signs scoped URLs without giving credentials to the server.
- `--s3-directory-markers=all|empty|none` controls which copied directories
  create 0-byte `dir/` markers on S3 destinations.
- Faster S3 operations (parallel prefix listing, empty-prefix HEAD skipping,
  unified `s3-requests` concurrency with throttling backoff, single-pass pooled
  uploads, batched storage-authorization signing) and faster filesystem/SSH
  copies (lower startup latency, transport-aware tuning history, pipelined
  planning lookups, byte-bounded streamed patch windows).
- Smaller standalone release binaries and `.tar.zst` release archives with
  automatic gzip fallback, plus Python 3.10+ support and musl Linux wheels.

## Compatibility changes

Install the same syq version on every machine involved in a copy. Receiving
services started by syq 0.7 or earlier are no longer switched automatically;
replace them with `syq persist connect HOST` or `syq persist receive on`.
The `bw-pacing` tuning key is removed (bandwidth-limited local and descriptor
copies now pace automatically), `--where` / `--copy-if` expressions use
3-valued `null` logic, and `syq --self-update` declines to overwrite a `syq`
executable installed by the Python package.

The matching Python package is published after the native release.

See the [0.11.0 changelog](https://github.com/greaber/syq/blob/v0.11.0/CHANGELOG.md)
for the complete behavior changes, compatibility notes and fixes.
